Fna3dRenderer::SamplerLodBiasReachesTheGpuEXT: false on Apple unless FNA3D runs its OpenGL driver; ApplySamplerMipState hands the bias to FNA3D
Sampler state that reaches the GPU: the per-backend MipMapLevelOfDetailBias row

added.evidence: Read at c1c316b9: the Metal sampler cache and its probe, FNA3D's SamplerLodBiasReachesTheGpuEXT, the shared mip contract test and CNA's records; nothing was executed here. The behaviour on devices is CNA's own measurement: AM4-296 records a CNA-free probe on the hosted runner's Apple Paravirtual device that samples level 0 at a +1 and a +2 sampler bias while the shader's own bias selects levels 1 and 2, and a Mac mini M4 that honours it; AM4-191 records that FNA3D's SDL_GPU driver on Metal ignores the bias. The pre-26 refusal follows from the @available guard and the SDK macro; CNA notes it was not executed against a real pre-26 SDK. Related but older and outside Apple: MipMapLevelOfDetailBias has no OpenGL ES equivalent, so EasyGL's OPENGLES3 and WEBGL2 identities accept it without effect, as {{src:docs/fx-compiled-effects.md|fx-compiled-effects.md}} documents.
added.tests_current: {{src:modules/graphics/examples/texture_filter_mip_contract_test.cpp|texture_filter_mip_contract_test.cpp}} draws one raw biased draw first and accepts a NotSupportedException on Metal only (any other renderer refusing fails); the FNA3D compiled-effect sampler contract passes SamplerLodBiasReachesTheGpuEXT() as its supportsLodBias option, so on Apple it skips the bias section. No test asserts the pre-26 refusal on a real older OS or SDK.
added.regression_test: The existing contract tests are the regression tests; what is missing is a run on macOS below 26 (or a build against an older SDK) that confirms the refusal, and, if FNA3D gains a shader route for the bias, removing the Apple exception from its sampler contract.
added.blast_radius: Games that set a non-zero MipMapLevelOfDetailBias: on METAL they get an exception on macOS/iOS below 26, from a build made with an older Xcode SDK, or on a GPU that ignores the bias (the hosted macOS CI runners); on FNA3D on Apple the textures are sampled as if the bias were 0. A bias of 0, every other sampler state, and the other renderers on Apple are unaffected.
added.workaround: Keep the bias at 0 on Apple, or catch the exception and fall back; alternatively bias the mip level in the shader of a compiled effect, which on the device CNA measured is honoured where the sampler's bias is ignored. Build METAL with an Xcode that ships the macOS/iOS 26 SDK when the sampler bias is needed.

added.origin: new finding at the c1c316b9 pin move: AM4-189 made FNA3D's OcclusionQuery capability follow its driver
added.title: FNA3D has no occlusion queries on its SDL_GPU driver, the driver FNA3D tries first and the one it runs on Apple
added.summary: Fna3dRenderer probes queries only on FNA3D's OpenGL and Direct3D 11 drivers; on its SDL_GPU driver (FNA3D's first choice, and its Metal route on Apple) OcclusionQuery is reported unsupported and its constructor refuses, because SDL3's GPU API has no queries.
added.public_contract: OcclusionQuery and GraphicsCapability::OcclusionQuery on the FNA3D renderer
added.expected: XNA 4.0 offers OcclusionQuery on every HiDef device. Where a backend cannot count samples, CNA's rule is to say so: the capability answers false and the constructor refuses by name rather than returning a fabricated count.
added.actual: FNA3D chooses its driver at run time in the order SDL_GPU, Direct3D 11, OpenGL ({{src:docs/fna3d-renderer.md|fna3d-renderer.md}}). At device creation Fna3dRenderer ({{src:modules/renderers/fna3d/src/Fna3dRenderer.cpp|Fna3dRenderer.cpp}}) probes query support with FNA3D_CreateQuery only when the chosen driver is not SDL_GPU; on the SDL_GPU driver supportsOcclusionQueries_ stays false, SupportsCapability(OcclusionQuery) answers false and Fna3dRenderer::CreateOcclusionQuery ({{src:modules/renderers/fna3d/src/Fna3dResources.cpp|Fna3dResources.cpp}}) returns no renderer, so the public OcclusionQuery constructor refuses with NotSupportedException. SDL3's GPU API has no occlusion-query commands (the same reason CNA's own SDL_GPU renderer refuses them). On Apple FNA3D runs that driver on Metal, so FNA3D has no occlusion queries there; elsewhere it has none unless FNA3D falls back to, or is pinned (FNA3D_FORCE_DRIVER) to, OpenGL or Direct3D 11.

added.origin: new finding at the c1c316b9 pin move: AM4-044 (14f74e81f) and AM4-123 (a1c0c4d91) make the relay refuse a libcurl without WebSockets by name, and CNA's Apple qualification records the macOS system libcurl as lacking it (owner decision in plans/plan_apple_m4.md AM4-044)
added.title: Online PlayerMatch and Ranked session traffic needs a libcurl with WebSocket support; with macOS's system libcurl the relay refuses with RELAY_SECURE_WEBSOCKET_UNAVAILABLE
added.summary: PlayerMatch and Ranked sessions carry their traffic over a WSS relay through libcurl's WebSocket API, so a libcurl without ws/wss and TLS (Apple's system libcurl 8.7.1, or one older than 7.86) refuses the relay and those sessions cannot run.
added.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::Net::NetworkSession Create, Join and JoinInvited for NetworkSessionType::PlayerMatch and Ranked with a configured CNA gamer-services endpoint; the realtime relay at /cna/relay/v1 and the push channel /cna/v1/events
added.expected: Once a CNA gamer-services endpoint is configured, online PlayerMatch and Ranked sessions work on every desktop host CNA builds for, as they do on Linux.
added.actual: Online session traffic (game data, voice, readiness) travels between machines through the service's authenticated WSS datagram relay, which CNA reaches through libcurl's WebSocket API (curl_ws_send/curl_ws_recv). Before it authenticates, {{src:modules/net/src/Internal/RelayWebSocket.cpp|RelayWebSocket.cpp}} checks the linked libcurl with relayTransportRefusal(): relayTransportRefusalFor refuses with RELAY_SECURE_WEBSOCKET_UNAVAILABLE unless the version is at least 7.86.0, its protocol list offers both ws and wss, and it has a TLS backend. Apple's system libcurl 8.7.1, which a macOS build links unless another curl is found, has no WebSocket support, so on such a build the relay never connects; the online session cannot become ready and, by reading {{src:modules/net/src/Internal/ServiceENetSession.cpp|ServiceENetSession.cpp}}, ends with a relay failure once its 15-second relay-recovery window has passed. The account's push channel (/cna/v1/events) uses the same libcurl WebSocket API in {{src:modules/gamer-services/src/Internal/GamerServicesBackend.cpp|GamerServicesBackend.cpp}}; without it the hints never arrive and the client falls back to its ordinary polling (invitations and parties every 5 seconds, messages and friends every 15). Sign-in, profiles, achievements, leaderboards, the session directory and SystemLink sessions do not use WebSockets and are unaffected. Before 14f74e81f the same build reported a misleading RELAY_CONFIGURATION instead of this refusal.

The capability rule is pinned by RelayTransportTest.RefusalNeedsWsAndWssWithTlsFromCurl7860 on synthetic version data (8.11 and 7.86.0 with ws/wss and TLS accepted; 7.85, Apple's 8.7.1 protocol list, ws without wss, no TLS and no protocol list refused). CNA's own record states the platform consequence: {{src:plans/plan_apple_m4.md|plan_apple_m4.md}} AM4-044 records the owner decision that with the system libcurl the relay cannot work on macOS and that Homebrew curl 8.22 has ws/wss, and {{src:docs/apple-platforms.md|apple-platforms.md}} records that a CNA build linking the SDK's libcurl 8.7.1 refuses the relay transport by name, so the server's harness-driven tests on the Mac needed a tree that found Homebrew curl. How the failure reaches a game (the relay-recovery window, then the session's failure code) was established by reading only. Which libcurl a given Linux distribution ships with WebSockets enabled was not surveyed; WebSockets became a default libcurl feature only in 8.11.

added.blast_radius: Games that use online PlayerMatch or Ranked sessions (and their voice) in builds linked against a libcurl without WebSocket support, notably macOS builds that link the system libcurl; push hints in such builds degrade to polling. Local, LocalWithLeaderboards and SystemLink sessions and the non-realtime gamer services are unaffected. iOS builds currently disable networking altogether, and an Android build without a target libcurl refuses the service as a browser does (CNA records both separately).
added.workaround: Build against a libcurl that offers ws and wss with TLS, for example Homebrew curl on macOS, so that CMake finds it before the system library.
